6b8a87fb5d.a: Franchises in America range from approximately $50,000 for home-based businesses and children's programs, up to millions of dollars for larger operations. 87f62d4830.q: What financing options are available to fund a franchise business beyond personal cash?
87f62d4830.a: Multiple financing options exist including SBA loans, 401k rollovers, ROBS (Rollover for Business Startups), personal credit, home equity lines, and IRA accounts. These tools allow candidates to come to the table with a percentage of the full investment rather than needing the complete amount upfront.
